# WO-204: Audit the refreshed website and rollback plan
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Hannah Cole
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Independently verify the integrated refresh and document route-by-route rollback points before owner review.

## Acceptance criteria
- Review changed pages at 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% display scaling, light/dark mode, keyboard-only use, and 200% zoom.
- Confirm tap targets are >=44px and D6 contrast holds in both themes (body >=7:1; other text >=4.5:1).
- Check overflow, broken links/images, reduced-motion behavior, and every copy claim against D8; flag unsupported claims.
- Confirm built HTML has no inline `style=` attributes and no new script hashes in the Astro CSP meta.
- Run build and site checks; record exact commands/results, limitations, and any defects without fixing source.
- List the PR/WO revert order: revert dependent page WOs before WO-195; remove unused WO-196 art separately. Verify the in-house fold-back/removal of the staging namespace after acceptance.
- Report findings with severity and exact route/element; no source code edits.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `docs/vendor/site-refresh/QA_REPORT.md` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No source fixes, tests, styles, assets, app, CI, release, publication, tracker writes, or merge actions.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`
- Manual browser and keyboard review at the listed sizes/modes; report tool/browser limitations.

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WOs 195–203 and 205–207 are integrated on the reviewed base.

## Notes and decisions
This is a read-only QA assignment except for the listed report and worktree status. Owner review and publication remain outside this vendor task.
